title: Dear Days journal
summary: A customizable 3D journal PWA (a book with pull tabs, stickers, frames and photos) where each user signs in, edits offline and syncs a private book to the cloud.

nodes.label: Journal owner
nodes.detail: A person who keeps a private journal in the app.

nodes.label: Boot (main.ts)
nodes.detail: Reads the session, opens the last book from IndexedDB or seeds one, then mounts the book.

nodes.label: Login and account UI
nodes.detail: Sign in, sign up, email code verification, password reset, account export and deletion.

nodes.label: Eye-tracking chibi
nodes.detail: Customizable login character whose eyes follow the cursor, with its editor.

nodes.label: 3D book and tabs
nodes.detail: The CSS 3D book with cover, page flips, pull tabs and ribbon bookmark.

nodes.label: Page canvas
nodes.detail: Free canvas where text, photos and stickers are dragged, rotated and resized.

nodes.label: Frames and tear tool
nodes.detail: Photo frames (polaroid, tape, film strip) and the freehand tear tool.

nodes.label: Sticker tray
nodes.detail: Built-in and generated sticker packs plus user uploads.

nodes.label: Customize panel
nodes.detail: Cover colour, texture, paper type, desk backgrounds and fonts.

nodes.label: Book state store
nodes.detail: In-memory book document with autosave, schema and subscribers.

nodes.label: IndexedDB cache
nodes.detail: Owner-scoped offline cache of books, drafts and media in the browser.

nodes.label: Cloud sync client
nodes.detail: Pushes whole-book snapshots with revisions and idempotent mutations; preserves both copies on conflict.

nodes.label: Service worker
nodes.detail: Workbox precache of the app and all self-hosted fonts for offline use.

nodes.label: /api/auth/*
nodes.detail: Better Auth handler: email/password, email OTP verification and reset, delete user.

nodes.label: /api/books, /api/sync
nodes.detail: Lists and reads books and applies revision-checked sync mutations.

nodes.label: /api/assets/*
nodes.detail: Creates asset records, uploads and streams private image bytes by owner.

nodes.label: /api/account/*
nodes.detail: Exports account data and reads or saves the chibi settings.

nodes.label: Email sender
nodes.detail: Sends verification and reset codes over a bounded TLS SMTP connection.

nodes.label: Account write lock
nodes.detail: Advisory lock that serializes writes against account deletion.

nodes.label: Neon Postgres
nodes.detail: Auth tables plus journal_books, journal_assets and journal_account_state.

nodes.label: Cloudflare R2
nodes.detail: Private bucket journal-assets-prod holding uploaded images.

nodes.label: Gmail SMTP
nodes.detail: Delivers the one-time codes to users' inboxes.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Pages
nodes.detail: Hosts the Vite static build and runs the Hono API as a Pages Function.
